purpose: Refresh the living Runner Division and H3 handoffs after sealing the named Larry Turbo v4-600 cold action pair and its runtime external-node admission checks. This is a static census revision only: no GPU, server, or OTR operation occurred.

previous_receipt.retention: The 2026-08-13 census remains an unchanged historical receipt; this successor does not rewrite its claims.

vram_recipe_lab.read_surface: Git-tracked files only at the named commit; untracked scratch files were excluded.

otr.read_surface: Unchanged read-only OTR snapshot carried forward from the prior census; this lab-only revision did not operate on OTR.

method.recipe_count: Count git-tracked recipes/*.json files at the named lab commit.
method.alias_selection: Inspect only tracked top-level results/<stem>.json files: require direct parent results, exclude stems containing _run, parse JSON, and retain an object only when recipe equals stem. Nested Front Office receipts under results/runs/ are deliberately outside this historical-alias predicate.
method.same_name_current_alias: A selected alias whose stem is a checked-in recipe stem.
method.orphan_alias: A selected alias whose stem is not a checked-in recipe stem.
method.modern_schema: A selected same-name alias with integer receipt_schema_version >= 2; all other selected same-name aliases are legacy.
method.appearing_warm: A selected same-name alias whose string status starts with PASS and does not contain (cold), case-insensitive. This is a display predicate, not a promotion verdict.
method.active_runner_binding: Recursively search selected alias JSON values for exact equality with the active run_recipe.py SHA-256.
method.otr_carry_forward: Retain the unchanged OTR profile/lane counts and Sage correction from the named read-only snapshot in the prior census receipt.

lab_census.front_office_nested_receipt_note: Current Front Office receipts are under results/runs/ and are intentionally not counted as top-level historical aliases.

admission.scope: One named current-0.32 cold I2V control/candidate pair only; no warm-cache certification or promotion claim.

sealed_turbo_pair.fixed_surface: Current ComfyUI 0.32, FL2VA I2V, 864x480, 124 frames at 24 fps, seed 42, identical action prompt/fixture/base weights/native A/V path, Sage-free boot, and simple scheduler.
sealed_turbo_pair.declared_delta: The candidate adds the reviewed Larry v4-600 LoRA and sampler node plus the necessarily distinct custom-node/profile manifest, and changes simple-scheduler steps from 20 to 8.
sealed_turbo_pair.runtime_admission_proof: Before allocation, the sealed runner must verify the pinned external node classes through /object_info, exact node source identity, full LoRA and support-asset bytes/SHA-256, and the support asset's hard-link identity to the managed model tree.

h3_lane_packets: lane21-h3_low_mime: standalone and deliberately unregistered runner, PASS

sage_attention_metadata.finding: No OTR launcher passes --use-sage-attention; production runs Sage-free, so the lab Sage-free boot is production parity.
sage_attention_metadata.runtime_safeguard: The distinct H3 assert_sage_not_patched check remains live and is not the dead metadata field.
